title: A Thorn for the Ember
author: Rosalind Underhill
blurb: Lena Hartwell, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
